name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 7 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2026-06-06, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.39 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
